story.iWant: to manually add Q&A pairs to the Verified KB
story.soThat: I can seed common questions without waiting for HITL
story.tasks:
- [ ] **Task 1: UI - Add Entry Form** (AC: #1, #2) - [ ] Build Verified KB page section with "Add Entry" button - [ ] Implement form fields: question (textarea), answer (rich text), tags (chips) - [ ] Add client-side validation and submit states
- [ ] **Task 2: API - Create Entry** (AC: #2) - [ ] Add POST `/api/v1/verified-qa` with tenant/group/bot scope enforcement - [ ] Validate payload; embed question via nomic-embed-text (1024-d) - [ ] Save entry with citations placeholder (empty array by default)
- [ ] **Task 3: CSV Import** (AC: #3) - [ ] Support CSV upload (question, answer columns; optional tags ignored) - [ ] Validate row limits and required fields; batch embed and insert - [ ] Return summary of imported vs skipped rows
- [ ] **Task 4: List Refresh & UX** (AC: #2) - [ ] Refresh list after create/import without full page reload - [ ] Toast/alert on success or failure; preserve pagination/search state
- [ ] **Task 5: Authorization & Validation** (AC: all) - [ ] Enforce tenant_id/group_id/bot_id scoping and deduplicate per bot (case-insensitive) - [ ] Sanitize rich text inputs to prevent XSS
- [ ] **Task 6: Testing** (AC: all) - [ ] Unit tests for payload validation and CSV parsing edge cases - [ ] Integration tests for create and import flows - [ ] UI tests: validation messages, success states, list refresh

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** I am on the Verified KB page **When** I click "Add Entry" **Then** I see a form with: Question (required), Answer (required, rich text), Tags (optional)
2. **When** I submit **Then** the entry is added to Verified KB **And** question is embedded automatically **And** entry appears in the list
3. **I can bulk import from CSV** with columns: question, answer

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 7.3: Manual Q&A Entry - allow users to add verified entries and import via CSV.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Users can manually add Verified KB entries and bulk import Q&A pairs.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Embedding service shared across document chunks and verified questions; enforce tenant/group/bot scoping.

artifact.reason: UI surface for add/import forms and list refresh.
POST endpoint for creating entries and handling CSV upload.
Reuse embedding pipeline (nomic-embed-text) for manual entries.

story-context.constraints: - Enforce tenant/group/bot scoping on create/import and reject duplicates per bot. - Embed questions with same model/dimension as documents (nomic-embed-text 1024-d per story spec). - Sanitize rich-text answers; cap question length (<=2000) and answer length (<=8000). - CSV uploads must validate row limits and required columns before embedding.
